title: ネオンレインの追走曲
author: ネオン 零

en.title: Neon Rain: Pursuit Song
en.premise: Having ripped confidential data from the heart of a megacorp's network, I tear through the depths of the slums, dodging swarms of pursuing drones. Hidden within the packet is an old-world flight code—a ticket to the skies beyond the reach of control. Through neon streets drenched in acid rain, I race toward the lost Promised Hill.

zh.title: 霓虹雨的追逐曲
zh.premise: 从巨型企业的网络中枢窃取机密数据后，我一边躲避追击的无人机群，一边在贫民窟的底层疾驰。而隐藏在手中的数据包里，竟是前往管理之外之空的旧时代飞行代码。穿过酸雨飘落的霓虹街头，我向着那座失落的“约定之丘”进发。
